title: Volterra Sweeping Processes with Multivalued Perturbations under Compactness Conditions
summary: We study integro-differential sweeping processes of Volterra type in a separable Hilbert space, in which the velocity is governed by the normal cone to a prox-regular moving set and is driven by an outer set-valued perturbation together with a history-dependent integral term that endows the dynamics with memory. The perturbation is assumed measurable, with closed convex values, of linear growth, and upper semicontinuous from the strong to the weak topology.
